question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 9. **
solution:
The correct answer is: an

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given articles.
 
 
• "**The**" is a **definite article** used before a noun to indicate that the** identity of the noun is known to the reader.**
 
• "One" is a gender-neutral, **indefinite pronoun** that means, roughly, **"a person"**.
 
• The **indefinite article** **"A"** is used before a noun that is general or when its identity is not known.** "A" goes before words that begin with consonants**.
 
• "**An**" is also an **indefinite article** that **goes before words that begin with vowels**.
 
 
 
• *​*As per the use of the given articles "an"* *is the appropriate option to fill in the blank because the word **"actress" **starts with the vowel** 'A'.**

Hence, the correct answer is: option 4.

Complete Paragraph: *One day, my six-year-old sister (1) asked __us which career she should (2) __opt __for. My father suggested (3) __that __she should become a doctor, (4) __While __my mother said she could (5) __become__ a newspaper reporter. I (6) __believed __she would make a (7) __fine __teacher. After a brief (8) __silence __my sister declared, “I will become (9) __**an **__actress. Then I will get an (10)______ to play all these roles.”*
